messages:
Maria P: Quick design huddle: finalizing request drilldown header actions for tomorrow's sprint. Need clear copy + a11y before handoff.

Josh D: Proposed compact header: status dot + short id + time + two icon buttons (copy ID, download). Download should open a tiny menu: JSON / CSV.

Nora A11y: A11y rules: buttons must have aria-labels including short id; download menu needs role="menu" semantics; announce expansion with polite live region: "Trace details opened for request <id>".

Sam K: Performance note: virtualize list, only mount expanded trace on demand. Backend will serve `GET /api/v1/traces/{id}?format=json`. Frontend streams download.

Lily QA: QA checklist: keyboard nav to header, Enter/Space expands, focus goes into panel, Shift+Tab returns to header, copy action announces success, download filename includes corrID and iso date.

Maria P: Copy debate: use "Download trace (JSON)" in menu and tooltip. Avoid vague terms like "snapshot". Consensus?

Josh D: Agrees. Short tooltip + explicit menu items.

Nora A11y: Also ensure color alone isn't the only status indicator; include small textual label or aria-label on the status.

Maria P: Great. Action items: Josh updates Figma copy, Sam wires endpoint with ETag, Lily adds QA tests, Nora adds a11y checklist for PR. I'll summarise in the PR description. :thumbsup:
